correctness.rationale: With outside-vertex open-neighborhood traces, a graph non-star LD set is exactly a vertex cover of H, where H has cliques on each nonsingleton part and a clique on singleton-part vertices. Both directions hold because covers select vertices from at least two distinct parts, hence all outside traces nonempty and distinguishable. A coalition partition induces a looped quotient graph J on blocks: no singleton vertex cover, every index in at least one size-two vertex cover. In such a graph at most four indices can appear: two disjoint constraints force at most four possible endpoints, while no disjoint edges and no one-cover force a triangle, at most three. Four blocks rule out triangle cliques and require H to be a matching with two or more edges; explicit cross-pair construction gives four. Twin-pair plus remainder yields three, with stars handled by direct LD minimum m and pairwise coalition bound. Formula C_L=4 iff max part<=2, singleton count<=2 and (#2-parts)+1_{#singleton=2}>=2; otherwise 3, for r>=2 and N>=3. Independently exhaustively enumerated all LD subsets and all set partitions for 36 part-size profiles N3..7; every case matched. Inspected actual verifier for larger n and graph-lemma check; finite tests corroborate unrestricted proof.
